# azurefd.net
> Azure Front Door is Microsoft’s global edge network service for application acceleration, load balancing, content delivery, and web application protection.

This site hosts Azure Front Door endpoints and related Microsoft Learn documentation for configuring routing, origins, caching, security, and edge delivery patterns across Azure services.

## Product Overview
- [Azure Front Door documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/): Central documentation hub for Azure Front Door concepts, deployment, and operations.
- [What is Azure Front Door?](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-overview): Overview of Azure Front Door features, architecture, and common use cases.
- [Tier comparison](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/standard-premium/tier-comparison): Compare Standard, Premium, and classic Front Door capabilities and limits.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-faq): Answers to common questions about features, behavior, pricing, and migration.

## Quickstarts
- [Create a Front Door profile and endpoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/create-front-door-portal): Create and configure Azure Front Door using the Azure portal.
- [Create Front Door with Bicep](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/quickstart-create-front-door-bicep): Deploy Azure Front Door resources using a Bicep template.
- [Create Front Door with ARM template](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/quickstart-create-front-door-template): Provision Azure Front Door using an Azure Resource Manager template.
- [Create Front Door with Terraform](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/quickstart-create-front-door-terraform): Deploy Azure Front Door infrastructure using Terraform.
- [Route traffic to a web app](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-route-traffic): Configure Front Door to direct traffic to backend web applications.

## Routing and Origins
- [Routing architecture](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-routing-architecture): Understand how routes, domains, origins, and rule sets work together.
- [Origins and origin groups](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/origin): Configure backend origins, health probes, and load-balancing behavior.
- [Health probes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/health-probes): Learn how Front Door monitors origin health and failover readiness.
- [Load balancing](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/load-balancing): Configure latency, priority, and weighted load-balancing across origins.
- [Rule sets](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/rules-match-conditions): Use rule sets and match conditions to modify requests and responses.
- [URL redirect and rewrite](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-url-redirect): Configure redirects and URL rewrites at the edge.

## Domains, TLS, and Certificates
- [Custom domains](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/domain): Add and validate custom domains for Front Door endpoints.
- [HTTPS and TLS configuration](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/end-to-end-tls): Configure end-to-end TLS between clients, Front Door, and origins.
- [Managed certificates](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/standard-premium/how-to-configure-https-custom-domain): Enable HTTPS on custom domains using managed certificates.
- [Bring your own certificate](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/standard-premium/how-to-configure-https-custom-domain#use-your-own-certificate): Use your own certificate for custom domain HTTPS.
- [Domain validation](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/domain#domain-validation): Validate domain ownership for onboarding and certificate issuance.

## Caching and Performance
- [Caching](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-caching): Configure edge caching behavior, TTLs, and cache-control interactions.
- [Compression](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-caching#file-compression): Enable compression for supported content types and improve delivery performance.
- [Query string caching behavior](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-caching#query-string-behavior): Control cache keys and query string handling for cached content.
- [Large file delivery](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-caching#delivery-of-large-files): Understand large file optimization and delivery behavior through Front Door.
- [Performance tuning](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-routing-architecture): Optimize routing and edge delivery for lower latency and resilience.

## Security and WAF
- [Web Application Firewall documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/web-application-firewall/afds/): Documentation for WAF on Azure Front Door.
- [WAF policy overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/web-application-firewall/afds/waf-front-door-policy-overview): Learn how WAF policies protect Front Door applications.
- [Managed rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/web-application-firewall/afds/waf-front-door-drs): Use Microsoft-managed rule sets for common web threats.
- [Custom rules](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/web-application-firewall/afds/waf-front-door-custom-rules): Create custom WAF rules for filtering and access control.
- [Bot protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/web-application-firewall/afds/bot-protection-overview): Mitigate malicious bot traffic with bot protection capabilities.
- [Rate limiting](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/web-application-firewall/afds/waf-front-door-rate-limit-configure): Configure rate-limiting rules to protect applications from abuse.

## Private Link and Premium Features
- [Private Link with Front Door](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/private-link): Secure origin connectivity using Azure Private Link.
- [Enable Private Link to origins](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/standard-premium/how-to-enable-private-link-web-app): Connect Front Door Premium to supported private origins.
- [Origin security](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/origin-security): Restrict origin access and secure traffic between Front Door and backends.
- [Managed identity support](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/managed-identity): Use managed identities with supported Front Door scenarios.

## Automation and API
- [REST API reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/frontdoor/): REST API reference for Azure Front Door resource management.
- [Azure Resource Manager template reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/templates/microsoft.cdn/profiles): ARM template schema for Front Door Standard and Premium profiles.
- [Azure CLI reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/cli/azure/afd): Azure CLI commands for managing Front Door Standard and Premium.
- [Azure PowerShell reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/az.cdn/): PowerShell cmdlets for Front Door and CDN resource management.
- [Bicep resource reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/templates/microsoft.cdn/profiles): Bicep and ARM resource definitions for Front Door deployments.
- [Terraform provider docs](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/azurerm/latest/docs/resources/cdn_frontdoor_profile): Terraform resources for Azure Front Door profiles and related objects.

## Monitoring and Operations
- [Monitoring data reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/monitor-front-door-reference): Metrics, logs, and diagnostic data available for Front Door.
- [Diagnostic logs](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/standard-premium/how-to-logs): Enable and use diagnostic logging for Front Door.
- [Metrics and alerts](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/monitor-front-door): Monitor Front Door health, performance, and configure alerts.
- [Troubleshooting](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/troubleshoot-issues): Diagnose common Front Door configuration and traffic issues.
- [Service limits and quotas](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-routing-limits): Review limits, quotas, and scale-related constraints.

## Migration and Legacy
- [Migrate from Front Door classic](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/migrate-tier): Guidance for migrating from Front Door classic to Standard or Premium.
- [Classic retirement information](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-overview#front-door-classic): Notes on Front Door classic status and newer service tiers.
- [Compare Front Door and Application Gateway](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-faq#what-is-the-difference-between-azure-front-door-and-azure-application-gateway): Understand differences between Front Door and Application Gateway.
- [Compare Front Door and Traffic Manager](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/frontdoor/front-door-faq#what-is-the-difference-between-azure-front-door-and-azure-traffic-manager): Understand differences between Front Door and Traffic Manager.
